reason: A DSH plugin that lets one session work with multiple project folders declared through VS Code-compatible workspace files, including filesystem and limited shell write-scope synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供基于 VS Code 工作区文件的多项目文件夹管理，并同步文件系统与受支持 shell 工具的写入范围。
summaries.en: Manage multiple project folders in one DSH session through VS Code-compatible workspace files while synchronizing filesystem and supported shell write scopes.

capabilities: Adds multiple project folders to a DSH session
Extends writable filesystem scope to declared workspace folders
Synchronizes shell write permissions with workspace folder changes
Provides sidebar controls for opening and modifying workspaces
